name: Mizushina Makoto
source:
[b]A Lingering Spirit・Lover[/b]

Age: 20 years old (Was)
Height: Slightly tall
Bust: Average

[url=/c166953]The protagonist[/url]'s late girlfriend.

She was working as a street performer.

With his supernatural ability, the protagonist goes out every night, searching for the person responsible for her death.
